svg.title: rustybladerunner — vault terminal
svg.desc: A Ghostty-style glass terminal over Matrix rain. A vault terminal lock screen is hacked, then the vault record for rustybladerunner is dumped: surface impossibletask.dev; public repos vigilant-cogwheel, alphalight, signaled-gear, Integrated-API-Bridge, aldertrace, jev-skills; an unnamed private experiment; stack Rust, TypeScript, Python, local inference; most of the work is not on GitHub.
